description: Add one new node type to the schema; use to extend an existing schema without resending the whole thing (cheaper than naumu_update_schema). STRUCTURAL RULES: (1) Schemas are hierarchical with a single root. If schema is empty, the first type IS the root - omit `parent`. Every subsequent type MUST set `parent`. (2) DEFAULT TO CONCRETE - pass {relation, target_node: <existing type>}. Polymorphic is the ESCAPE HATCH - use {relation, polymorphic: true} ONLY for genuinely cross-cutting concepts like Comment or Tag (types that validly attach to many distinct parents). If you can't pick a concrete parent, you may be missing a type - add the missing type first instead of falling back to polymorphic. (3) Required/suggested connections also each take ONE concrete target_node OR polymorphic - never a list. Default concrete there too. (4) Type name PascalCase. Relation names UPPER_SNAKE_CASE. (5) ALWAYS provide `description` - one short sentence that says what this type is AND what it is NOT relative to semantically close types (e.g. "Type A — distinct from Type B, which is broader"). This is the single strongest signal future agents have when classifying a node into one of several similar-sounding types. Returns an error if the type already exists - use naumu_add_attribute / naumu_add_connection to extend it.

description.description: Short note explaining what this attribute captures and how it differs from similarly-named attributes on other types (e.g. "stage on Type A" vs "stage on Type B"). Strongly encouraged.

multiple.description: person only - allow several members. The node value becomes a list of members (write it as an array or a comma-separated list of names/emails).

requiredOnWrite.description: True when every write that creates or updates a node of this type must also set this attribute.

type.description: Attribute type (required). select/multiselect define a closed set of categories with values; string/number/boolean/date/person hold per-node data with values []. Calendar dates use "date", not select values. "person" references one space member (owner, assignee), or several when `multiple` is true.

description.description: Short note distinguishing this value from sibling values (e.g. for status="closed-won", "signed and revenue committed"). Encouraged when the label alone is ambiguous.

defaultVisibility.description: Default visibility for NEW nodes of this type when no explicit visibility is passed on creation. Does NOT retroactively change existing nodes. "open" = visible to anyone with the space link, "internal" = visible to all space members, "restricted" = only members explicitly granted access. Omit to fall back to the space-level defaultVisibility.

description.description: Short one-sentence description of what this type represents and how it differs from sibling types. Contrastive (say what it IS and what it is NOT) is most useful. Strongly encouraged on every new type - agents reading the schema later rely on this to classify nodes.

parent.description: Optional parent connection - sets this type as a child of another type.

polymorphic.description: True when this relation can target many types.

target_node.description: Target type name. Omit when polymorphic=true.

name: naumu_add_node_type
title: Add Node Type to Schema
